assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and optimize rate control.
The claim was denied under code PR-204.
